gaunt_wolf.name: Gaunt Timber-Wolf

visibleGear.weapon: Cracked yellow fangs slick with frozen saliva
visibleGear.armor: Matted, mangy winter pelt over bare ribs
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Porcupine quills and rusted trap-wire scar its left foreleg.

anatomy.faceDetail: Hollow cheeks draw back over chipped fangs and frost-rimmed whiskers.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Every rib shows sharply under patchy winter fur.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Split paw pads leave dark blood-specks on frozen mud.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Tucked hindquarters coil low, tail clamped tight between hocks.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Half an ear torn clean off by rival pack-jaws.

gaunt_wolf.firstSightProse: Dry brush snaps behind a fallen milestone as a starved, mangy canine pads into the sleet. Its ribs show like barrel staves through patchy grey fur, and frozen blood crusts around its parted jaws.
gaunt_wolf.returnSightProse: A Gaunt Timber-Wolf circles low through the slush, fangs bared.
gaunt_wolf.description: Driven onto the High Road by winter famine, snapping at anything warm that limps.

frost_boar.name: Frost-Tusked Boar

visibleGear.weapon: Jagged lower tusks stained with frozen clay and bark
visibleGear.armor: Inch-thick mud-caked hide along the shoulders
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A snapped southern spear-tip sits rusted deep behind its left ear.

anatomy.faceDetail: Tiny bloodshot eyes glare above curved, dirt-packed tusks.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Thick cartilage shield-plates armor both hunched shoulders.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Cloven forehooves tear deep ruts into frozen turf.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Short, muscular legs brace hard to charge straight ahead.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Rusted iron spear-barb jutting crookedly from its neck hump.

frost_boar.firstSightProse: Frozen moss flies upward in clumps as a thick-shouldered hog roots furiously under dead orchard trees. Frost coats its coarse black bristles, and curved yellow tusks click together as small red eyes lock onto your boots.
frost_boar.returnSightProse: A Frost-Tusked Boar paws frozen dirt, lowering its scarred snout.
frost_boar.description: A scarred northern boar rooting Dead Orchard tubers, maddened by cold and rusted iron in its hide.

intents.label: Tusk Charge
intents.description: lowers its bristled skull to charge.

intents.label: Hide Brace
intents.description: turns its thick shoulder-plate toward you.

carrion_crow_flock.name: Carrion Rookery

visibleGear.weapon: Dozens of hooked beaks and frost-wet talons
visibleGear.armor: Swarming scatter of wet black feathers
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Several birds carry shredded wool and dried flesh clamped in their claws.

anatomy.faceDetail: Wet black eyes gleam beside heavy beaks crusted in frozen gore.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Swollen crops bulge beneath sleet-soaked plumage.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Pinion feathers snap loud like wet leather in the wind.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Hops sideways across frozen corpses with crooked black talons.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Smells sharply of sour carrion and wet feathers.

carrion_crow_flock.firstSightProse: A dozen bloated black birds burst off a half-eaten pack-mule with deafening croaks, wheeling low around your head. Wet wingtips slap your hood while hooked beaks snap straight toward your eyes.
carrion_crow_flock.returnSightProse: The Carrion Rookery descends in a screaming black cloud.
carrion_crow_flock.description: Bold, corpse-fed crows that flock wherever travelers freeze or limp along the northern road.

mire_rat_pack.name: Cellar Rat-Pack

visibleGear.weapon: Chisel-sharp yellow incisors smeared with grain-rot
visibleGear.armor: Matted, scabby pelts crusted in wet cellar filth
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Chalk-white mold spots the hairless tails of the largest breeders.

anatomy.faceDetail: Twitching whiskers frame stained yellow teeth and wet red eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Bloated bellies drag low over damp flagstones.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Pink, needle-clawed forepaws scrabble across boot-leather.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Skittering pack darts in and out of wall cracks.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Hairless tails whip behind them like wet twine.

mire_rat_pack.firstSightProse: High-pitched squeaks echo off damp stone as a swarming knot of bloated, mange-spotted rodents pours out from a split drain-grate. Raw pink tails whip through grey slush as yellow teeth snap at your boot-tops.
mire_rat_pack.returnSightProse: A Cellar Rat-Pack swarms out from cracked stone drains.
mire_rat_pack.description: Filth-bloated rats driven out of Timber Post granaries and Old Bathhouse drains.

intents.label: Gnaw
intents.description: sinks chisel teeth into cloth and skin.

snow_lynx.name: Pale Ridge-Lynx

visibleGear.weapon: Curved ice-white claws and needle canines
visibleGear.armor: Thick frost-grey fur blending against stone
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Dry pine needles and frozen blood cake its tufted belly.

anatomy.faceDetail: Tufted ears flatten sharply beside cold ice-green eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Deep winter ruff hides coiled shoulder muscle.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Wide, furred paws spread broad over crusted snow without sound.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Coiled hind legs spring silently off broken steps.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Bobbed tail twitches once before every pounce.

snow_lynx.firstSightProse: Not a pebble shifts before a pale, thick-furred wildcat drops silently off a broken lintel onto the snow. Tufted ears flatten flat to its skull as wide paws sink noiselessly toward your flank.
snow_lynx.returnSightProse: A Pale Ridge-Lynx crouches motionless against frost-white stone.
snow_lynx.description: Silent highland predator stalking lone scavengers along Long Steps and High Road ridges.

intents.label: Rake Claws
intents.description: whips barbed forepaws across your guard.

ash_hound.name: Slag-Chewing Hound

visibleGear.weapon: Blistered jaws weeping black slag-tar
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A swallowed furnace clinker glows dull orange inside its split throat.

anatomy.faceDetail: Cracked gums drip black grease around scorched yellow teeth.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Sunken flanks heave roughly, smelling of sulfur and burnt hair.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Charred paws scrape sparks off dry stone.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Crouches trembling on brittle, soot-caked hocks.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Faint orange heat leaks between its parted ribs.

ash_hound.firstSightProse: Bitter coal-smoke curls out of a wrecked ditch before a starved, hair-singed mastiff crawls into view. Blisters bubble black along its split muzzle, and dull orange heat glimmers between its jagged teeth.
ash_hound.returnSightProse: A Slag-Chewing Hound slinks out of the mist, black grease dripping from its jaws.
ash_hound.description: Feral hound maddened by chewing hot furnace cinders along Brick Hills and High Road.

intents.label: Cinder Snap
intents.description: coughs hot sparks across its fangs.

chitin_weaver.name: Brine-Spinner

visibleGear.weapon: Acid-dripping chelicerae and six hooked legs
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Acid glands swell translucent green behind its mandibles.

anatomy.faceDetail: Smooth eyeless shell splits open over glistening green mandibles.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Overlapping lime-white plates rattle softly as it breathes.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Six jointed legs end in needle-sharp spurs.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Skates sideways across wet reeds and sulfur crust.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Trailing acid silk drips off its swollen abdomen.

chitin_weaver.firstSightProse: Wet reeds hiss softly as a six-legged, bone-white crawler drops from a sulfur vent. Smooth and eyeless across the crown, it taps frozen mud with jointed forelimbs while green acid beads along its mandibles.
chitin_weaver.returnSightProse: A Brine-Spinner clicks out of the sulfur steam, legs poised wide.
chitin_weaver.description: Blind sulfur-vent arachnid nesting across Salt Bog drains, spitting lye-sharp bile.

intents.label: Spur Lunge
intents.description: rears back on four hind legs.

intents.label: Shell Tuck
intents.description: locks its pale carapace plates tight.

star_stag.name: Vine-Strangled Stag

visibleGear.weapon: Twelve-point antlers wrapped in glassy pale vines
visibleGear.armor: Bark-hard hide knotted with dry root-cord
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Frozen sap bleeds steadily where tight tendrils saw into its neck.

anatomy.faceDetail: Milky blind eyes bulge above nostrils crusted in frozen amber sap.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Tight pale vines dig deep furrows across heaving ribs.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Split forehooves slam down hard enough to crack frozen stone.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Tall, trembling legs paw brittle moss between white trunks.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Brittle glass-like twigs rattle along its wide rack.

star_stag.firstSightProse: Brittle white branches snap like glass as a towering, rib-scarred hart crashes through the frost-locked trees. Tight grey vines saw deep into its hide around the neck, and blind milky eyes roll wildly as it lowers a twelve-point rack.
star_stag.returnSightProse: The Vine-Strangled Stag stamps frozen moss, antlers clicking like bone.
star_stag.description: Maddened giant stag strangled by brittle White Timber vines, thrashing blindly at any sound.

intents.label: Antler Gore
intents.description: drops its knotted rack to gore.

intents.label: Sap Lash
intents.description: shakes brittle sap-shards from its hide.

quarry_centipede.name: Quarry Wire-Crawler

visibleGear.weapon: Saw-edged pincers dripping black quarry acid
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Broken bronze chain-links hang wedged between its rear segments.

anatomy.faceDetail: Broad, flat head sports twin serrated jaws smeared in black slime.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Twenty overlapping slate-black plates click over thirty-inch girth.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Dozens of hooked iron-hard legs grip sheer rock faces.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Coils smoothly around fallen quarry blocks before striking.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Snapped hoist-chain rings drag loudly behind its tail.

quarry_centipede.firstSightProse: Loose scree rattles down a forty-foot quarry bench as an arm-thick, multi-legged crawler ripples over a dressed stone block. Slate-black plates click loud in the cold air while dark acid drips steadily from its serrated pincers.
quarry_centipede.returnSightProse: A Quarry Wire-Crawler uncoils across the black stone cuts.
quarry_centipede.description: Armored segmented predator nesting under Black Quarry blocks, spitting acid strong enough to pit iron.

ossuary_bat.name: Salt-Blind Flitter

visibleGear.weapon: Needle-fanged snout and thumb-hooks
visibleGear.armor: Leathery grey wing-membranes dusted in salt
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Crusted salt-scabs coat its oversized, fluted ears.

anatomy.faceDetail: Huge pleated ears twitch around a snarling, needle-toothed muzzle.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Narrow ribcage pumps hard beneath a five-foot wingspan.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Hooked wing-thumbs tear sharply at hood and cheek.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Drops headfirst from iron ceiling grilles without warning.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: White salt crystals crust its dark wingtips.

ossuary_bat.firstSightProse: A piercing shriek rattles dry bones behind the iron grilles as a dog-sized winged shape drops straight from the dark vaulting. Huge pleated ears twitch in the draft while needle teeth snap inches from your throat.
ossuary_bat.returnSightProse: A Salt-Blind Flitter swoops out from the bone-cellar rafters.
ossuary_bat.description: Oversized, blind cave-bat roosting in Bone Cellars vaulting, hunting by ear-splitting shriek.

intents.label: Vault Shriek
intents.description: draws air into a swollen chest.

intents.label: Hooked Swoop
intents.description: tucks its salt-rimed wings to dive.

iron_deserter.name: Toll-Road Deserter

visibleGear.weapon: Notched levy-pike wrapped in dirty rag
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Keeps a small brass whistle and half a moldy oatcake hidden in his boot.

anatomy.faceDetail: Frost-split lips snarl over missing molars and a red cheek scar.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Soot-stained brigandine hangs loose on starved ribs.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Chapped knuckles choke tightly around seasoned oak.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Shifts shivering weight inside split leather boots.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Tattered garrison strip knotted tight around his left knee.

iron_deserter.firstSightProse: Steel scrapes stone behind an overturned supply cart as a gaunt, frostbitten man steps across the road, leveling a notched pike. His wool cloak smells of wet dog and stale sweat, and hollow eyes fix straight on your belt pouch.
iron_deserter.returnSightProse: A Toll-Road Deserter bars the flagstones with leveled iron.
iron_deserter.description: Stranded southern soldier robbing High Road travelers for dry bread and black Onyx.
iron_deserter.interrogateHint: Timber Post stores are spoiling from within, and half the garrison fights over firewood.

intents.label: Brace Shaft
intents.description: sets his butt-spike into cracked stone.

silk_assassin.name: Bathhouse Strangler

visibleGear.weapon: Twin thin-bladed dirks and greased garrote wire
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Carries three weighted copper plumb-bobs sewn into her hem for silent balance.

anatomy.faceDetail: Wet grey linen wraps tight across her eyes above a calm, bloodless jaw.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Silent charcoal wool clings close without a single metal buckle.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long, pale fingers twist greased copper wire taut between knuckles.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Barely makes a sound on frost-grit in soft felt soles.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Three pale brand-ticks etched below her left ear.

silk_assassin.firstSightProse: Not a boot scrapes before a slight, blindfolded figure slips out from behind a pillar, damp grey wool silent in the wind. Greased wire gleams taut between pale knuckles as her head cocks cleanly toward your breathing.
silk_assassin.returnSightProse: A Bathhouse Strangler glides forward, blindfolded head tilted to your steps.
silk_assassin.description: Blindfolded assassin dispatched from Old Bathhouse when their warm basin is plundered.
silk_assassin.interrogateHint: The bathhouse matron sends killers after anyone who steals salt and Onyx.

intents.label: Wire Garrote
intents.description: whips greased wire toward your neck.

intents.label: Gut Dirks
intents.description: slides twin needles beneath your ribs.

sir_vorne.name: Bronze Gate-Warden

visibleGear.weapon: Heavy bell-bronze greatblade notched from frost
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: An engraved southern watch-seal hangs frozen inside his left pauldron.

anatomy.faceDetail: Frostbitten grey skin shows dimly behind slotted bronze cheek-guards.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Heavy bell-cast bronze cuirass dented by years of sleet and stone.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Riveted gauntlets lock rigid around a two-handed hilt.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Greaved boots stand planted immovable across the arch.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Ice fuses his visor hinges half-shut.

sir_vorne.firstSightProse: Frost cracks off riveted bronze joints as a towering, plate-clad figure hefts a broad, pitted greatblade off the flagstones. Behind his slotted helm, pale eyes stare straight through you without a flicker of warmth.
sir_vorne.returnSightProse: The Bronze Gate-Warden raises his frost-rimmed bronze blade.
sir_vorne.description: Mad southern knight holding North Gate long after his relief froze or turned back.
sir_vorne.interrogateHint: Only the watch-word carved inside Long Steps can release him from his post.

intents.label: Iron Ring
intents.description: slams his pommel against bronze plate.

intents.label: Watch Stance
intents.description: locks broad greaves into the stone.

salt_poacher.name: Bog-Salt Poacher

visibleGear.weapon: Hooked flensing knife and sulfur-soaked sling
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Keeps a small leather sack of dried marsh-weed tucked under his belt.

anatomy.faceDetail: White salt crusts around red, peeling nostrils and cracked lips.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Stiff oilskin smells sharply of sulfur steam and boiled fat.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Salt-raw fingers grip a hooked skinning blade.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Skirts steaming mud-holes on wide bog-patters.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Carries a cracked copper kettle slung across his pack.

salt_poacher.firstSightProse: Steam parts beside a bubbling sulfur pit where a salt-crusted scavenger crouches over a copper pan. He whips a hooked skinning knife free the instant gravel crunches under your sole, teeth bared in a red, peeling face.
salt_poacher.returnSightProse: A Bog-Salt Poacher darts between steaming salt puddles, knife low.
salt_poacher.description: Desperate exile boiling contraband salt and mugging lone travelers in Salt Bog.
salt_poacher.interrogateHint: Old Soren at Dry Arch knows which bog vents carry clean salt and which choke your lungs.

kiln_flagellant.name: Cinder Flagellant

visibleGear.weapon: Heated iron link-flail
visibleGear.armor: Charred sackcloth rags over blistered ribs
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Bites a charred leather strap between his teeth to muffle screams.

anatomy.faceDetail: Blistered cheeks twitch around wide, unblinking bloodshot eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Raw, weeping burns crisscross a bare chest smeared in furnace soot.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Calloused fists wrap iron chain tight around bare knuckles.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Marches stiffly over sharp black slag in bare, blackened feet.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Hot iron links hiss faintly against his scarred shoulders.

kiln_flagellant.firstSightProse: Iron links clatter rhythmically across black slag as a half-naked, soot-blackened zealot staggers out from behind a brick kiln. Weeping blisters cover his bare shoulders, yet he swings a glowing length of chain straight toward your head.
kiln_flagellant.returnSightProse: A Cinder Flagellant whirls a hot iron chain over Brick Hills slag.
kiln_flagellant.description: Maddened apostate who burns his own flesh along Brick Hills flues to stave off creeping numbness.

intents.label: Iron Lash
intents.description: lashes his own back before lunging.

quarry_cannibal.name: Hungry Scavenger

visibleGear.weapon: Heavy bone-cleaver and rusted meat-hook
visibleGear.armor: Greasy apron over mismatched wool and leather
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Keeps strips of salted, unidentifiable jerky stuffed in his coat pocket.

anatomy.faceDetail: Greasy black hair hangs over feverish dark eyes and raw, red gums.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: A blood-caked hide apron stiffens over thick winter wool.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Stained knuckles white-grip a heavy butcher cleaver.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Crouches heavy beside broken hoist-carts.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Missing two fingertips on his left hand from frostbite.

quarry_cannibal.firstSightProse: Rusted meat-hooks clink inside a quarry tool-shed before a thick-shouldered man steps out wiping a broad cleaver on his greasy apron. His gums bleed raw in the cold, and his stare drops straight to the meat on your thighs.
quarry_cannibal.returnSightProse: A Hungry Scavenger hefts his blood-stained cleaver from the quarry shade.
quarry_cannibal.description: Starved Black Quarry exile who stopped waiting for grain and began hunting slower travelers.

intents.label: Meat Hook
intents.description: swings an iron hook toward your ribs.

robed_copyist.name: Mad Tally-Scribe

visibleGear.weapon: Sharpened iron stylus and heavy slate board
visibleGear.armor: Torn scholar wool stiff with frozen ink
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Scores of stolen Onyx rubbings fill his ragged satchel.

anatomy.faceDetail: Black ink smears pale cheeks below half-blind, squinting eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Moth-chewed robes rattle with loose tally-slates sewn inside.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Black-stained, frostbitten fingers clutch an iron chisel-stylus.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Skates unevenly down oversized tomb steps.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Carries cracked wire spectacles hanging off one ear.

robed_copyist.firstSightProse: Chalk scratches frantically against stone before a half-blind, ink-smeared figure lunges up from the dark steps, brandishing a sharpened iron stylus. Frozen wool clatters with sewn slates as he shrieks for your boots and charcoal.
robed_copyist.returnSightProse: A Mad Tally-Scribe scrabbles across the stone steps with an iron spike.
robed_copyist.description: Half-blind southern clerk maddened by Long Steps inscriptions, robbing travelers for paper and Onyx.

intents.label: Stylus Jab
intents.description: lunges with a sharpened iron spike.

orc_raider.name: Bone-Clubber

visibleGear.weapon: Femur-bound iron cudgel
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Strings of cracked human teeth rattle along its belt.

anatomy.faceDetail: Flat nose and jutting lower tusks frame snarling red-amber eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Thick barrel chest scars criss-cross under raw, stinking pelts.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long, knotty arms end in dirt-caked claws around heavy iron.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Bow-legged crouch lunges forward like a beast.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Cracked southern finger-bones braided into its scalp-lock.

orc_raider.firstSightProse: A wet guttural snarl breaks from the scrub as a squat, heavy-jawed brute scrambles over the broken wall. Lower tusks jut yellow past split lips, raw wolf-hide reeks of rancid fat, and a spiked bone club swings low for your knees.
orc_raider.returnSightProse: A Bone-Clubber charges low, spitting red froth.
orc_raider.description: Brutal, animalistic orc-kin raider prowling High Road and Dead Orchard for meat and scrap iron.

orc_skirmisher.name: Gut-Slinger

visibleGear.weapon: Barbed flint javelins smeared in offal
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Chews dried sinew constantly while crouching behind stone.

anatomy.faceDetail: Notched ears flatten back beside twitching yellow eyes and chipped tusks.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Thin, scarred ribs tighten under filthy dog-skin straps.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long forearms cock barbed javelins with snapping speed.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Hops sideways across scree like a starved ape.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Smears rancid grease across its arrowheads.

orc_skirmisher.firstSightProse: Flint grates against stone atop a broken pier before a hunched, mire-skinned savage hurls a barbed javelin straight down at your chest. Yellow eyes dart wildly while dirt-caked fingers already draw a second shaft.
orc_skirmisher.returnSightProse: A Gut-Slinger crouches behind broken stone, javelin cocked.
orc_skirmisher.description: Feral orc-kin ambush hunter pelting High Road travelers with filth-smeared flint.

intents.label: Flint Slash
intents.description: lunges in low with jagged stone.

orc_butcher.name: Marrow-Splitter

visibleGear.weapon: Notched iron slab-cleaver
visibleGear.armor: Wired quarry-slate plates over raw hide
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Cracks fresh marrow-bones with its molars between raids.

anatomy.faceDetail: Broken tusk-stumps frame blood-red eyes and a scarred, slavering jaw.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Slate quarry shards wire crudely across thick, scarred pectoral muscle.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Club-thick wrists swing a slab-cleaver effortlessly one-handed.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Heavy stomping stride cracks brittle ice beneath nailed hide.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Carries an iron pot-helmet hammered flat over its skull.

orc_butcher.firstSightProse: Heavy stone slabs scrape apart as a towering, slate-armored savage steps out from behind a brick kiln, chewing raw cartilage off a split femur. One broken tusk juts crooked past a slavering lip as it raises a notched iron cleaver.
orc_butcher.returnSightProse: A Marrow-Splitter stomps forward, hefting its heavy slab-cleaver.
orc_butcher.description: Brutal orc-kin pack alpha dominating Brick Hills and Black Quarry ruins.

orc_houndmaster.name: Pack-Whipper

visibleGear.weapon: Barbed iron whip-chain and short hatchet
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Snapped dog-collars jingle from its belt.

anatomy.faceDetail: Dog-bite scars furrow its cheek beside fierce amber eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Stitched dog-pelts hang stiff with dried blood and pitch.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Coiled iron chain wraps tight around scarred knuckles.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Darts low behind cover, whistling sharp through broken teeth.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Carries three rusted iron dog-hooks at its hip.

orc_houndmaster.firstSightProse: A sharp whistle pierces the sleet before a scarred, pelt-wrapped savage steps out snapping a barbed iron chain. Three rusted dog-hooks clank at its hip while yellow tusks bare in a vicious grin.
orc_houndmaster.returnSightProse: A Pack-Whipper snaps barbed iron chain across the gravel.
orc_houndmaster.description: Cruel orc-kin driver scarring feral hounds into attacking Timber Post patrols.

intents.label: Barbed Lash
intents.description: snaps iron barbs at your face.

intents.label: Hatchet Chop
intents.description: rushes in behind a whistling swing.

root_husk.name: Chalk-Ribbed Walker

visibleGear.weapon: Calcified splinter claws fused to finger bones
visibleGear.armor: Rotted wool tunic split over pale ribs
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Chalk-white spore-sacs pulse faintly inside its hollow throat.

anatomy.faceDetail: Sunken cheeks pull taut over chalk-white teeth and clouded eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Split ribs bow outward where white threads push through rotted wool.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Dry forearms harden into splintered bone claws.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Shambles forward on stiff knees that scrape flagstone.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Dry rattling ticks inside its open chest.

root_husk.firstSightProse: Wet gravel crunches in the mist as a stooped figure lurches out of the reeds. Its skin has turned chalk-grey, white threads push through its split wool shirt like pale ribs, and dry fingers harden into splintered bone claws.
root_husk.returnSightProse: A Chalk-Ribbed Walker staggers out of the fog, chest rattling.
root_husk.description: Hollowed exile whose chest split open with chalk-white rot in Salt Bog.

intents.label: Spore Cough
intents.description: heaves chalky rot-mist from its ribs.

intents.label: Bark-Harden
intents.description: plates its ribs in stiff pale crust.

blight_acolyte.name: Dome Cantor

visibleGear.weapon: Cracked bronze censer packed with frost-mold
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Its tongue has stiffened grey, humming flatly on every exhale.

anatomy.faceDetail: Blank white eyes stare unwaveringly above a blackened jaw.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Thin grey linen drapes over rattling, chalk-stained ribs.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long fingers swing a heavy bronze censer in slow arcs.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Glides unevenly across frost-drifts in bare, blackened feet.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Cold grey smoke leaks steadily from its parted lips.

blight_acolyte.firstSightProse: Bronze chains clink slowly in the cold draft as a tall, blank-eyed figure drifts out from behind a white pillar. Tattered grey linen hangs stiff with frost while a cracked bronze censer pours sour white smoke across the tiles.
blight_acolyte.returnSightProse: A Dome Cantor sways forward, swinging its smoking bronze censer.
blight_acolyte.description: Voiceless, hollowed figure swaying inside The White Dome pit, spreading choking frost-mold.

intents.label: Choking Censer
intents.description: swings sour white smoke across you.

intents.label: Bronze Chain
intents.description: whips the heavy censer toward your temple.

husk_kale.name: Shackled Deserter

visibleGear.weapon: Snapped iron wrist-chains and notched cleaver
visibleGear.armor: Rotted garrison mail crusted with pale rot
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A faded southern muster-badge still hangs pinned upside down inside his collar.

anatomy.faceDetail: Milky eyes stare blankly above a slack, frost-split mouth.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Rusted mail rings bulge outward over chalk-white growths.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Heavy iron shackles swing from thick, grey-veined wrists.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Drags one stiffened boot loudly across cracked flagstones.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Snapped iron chain drags behind his left ankle.

husk_kale.firstSightProse: Heavy iron links scrape across paving stones as a broad-shouldered figure drags himself out of the fog. Rusted mail plates bulge apart over chalk-grey skin, and snapped shackles swing from wrists locked tight around a notched blade.
husk_kale.returnSightProse: A Shackled Deserter lurches through the mist, dragging snapped iron chains.
husk_kale.description: Former High Road deserter abandoned to creeping numbness, haunting the viaduct arches.

intents.label: Hollow Cough
intents.description: rasps wet spore-mist from split mail.

hollow_watchman.name: Frost-Locked Sentry

visibleGear.weapon: Frost-rimmed halberd
visibleGear.armor: Timber Post leather and rusted breastplate
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: His eyelids have frozen open without blinking.

anatomy.faceDetail: Blue-grey lips part silently around frost-glazed eyes that never blink.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Rusted breastplate straps tight over frozen wool.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Blackened, frostbitten fingers lock stiff around a halberd shaft.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Marches with rigid, mechanical steps across frozen ruts.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Carries a cracked wooden tally-horn frozen to his belt.

hollow_watchman.firstSightProse: Stiff leather creaks in the wind as a frostbitten sentry marches mechanically out of the dark. Ice coats his rusted breastplate, his eyelids never blink, and blackened fingers lock rigid around a raised halberd.
hollow_watchman.returnSightProse: A Frost-Locked Sentry advances stiffly with leveled halberd.
hollow_watchman.description: Former Timber Post watchman who wandered north under a full moon and returned silent and cold.

intents.label: Frozen Brace
intents.description: locks stiff joints behind rusted iron.

silver_sleeper.name: Frost-Caked Remnant

visibleGear.weapon: Ice-hard bare fists
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Metallic pale dust fills every wrinkle of its skin.

anatomy.faceDetail: Smooth, bloodless face shows zero expression as grey dust settles in its lashes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Fine rotted wool hangs heavy with tarnished metallic grit.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Dead-cold knuckles swing silently without bracing.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Steps across pale marble without altering expression or breath.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Leaves faint silver dust prints wherever its boots land.

silver_sleeper.firstSightProse: White dust puffs off marble tiles as a tall, bloodless figure turns smoothly from a colonnade. Tarnished metallic grit coats its tattered coat and unblinking lashes, and it raises dead-cold fists without a single word or breath.
silver_sleeper.returnSightProse: A Frost-Caked Remnant glides forward across the pale paving.
silver_sleeper.description: Voiceless, dust-coated wanderer drifting near North Gate and The White Dome.

intents.label: Dead Strike
intents.description: drives a freezing fist toward your sternum.

intents.label: Blank Stare
intents.description: fixes unblinking silver eyes on yours.

salt_corpse.name: Brine-Cured Corpse

visibleGear.weapon: Salt-hardened nails and rusted iron grille-bar
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Dry white salt pours from its parted ribs when struck.

anatomy.faceDetail: Dry leather skin shrinks tight across toothy gums and empty sockets.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Salt crystals crust inside an open ribcage like dried beef.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Stiff, parchment-hard fingers lock around rusted iron.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Dry knee-tendons pop loudly with every lurch.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Smells sharply of lime, brine, and dry cellar dust.

salt_corpse.firstSightProse: Dry tendons crack like kindling behind an iron grille as a leathery, salt-cured corpse pulls itself upright from the bone pile. Empty eye-sockets turn toward your lantern while parchment-hard fingers drag a rusted iron bar.
salt_corpse.returnSightProse: A Brine-Cured Corpse lurches out of the salt drifts, joints popping.
salt_corpse.description: Salt-preserved dead rising from disturbed niches inside Bone Cellars.

intents.label: Dry Claw
intents.description: rakes brittle nails at your face.

barrow_wight.name: Long-Stride Skeleton

visibleGear.weapon: Oversized notched bronze broadsword
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Its femurs and stride measure nearly seven feet tall.

anatomy.faceDetail: Elongated yellow skull stares down from a head taller than any human.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Green-tarnished bronze scales hang loose over broad, tall ribs.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long bone fingers weld tight around a heavy bronze hilt.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Takes sweeping, unnatural strides across oversized stair treads.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Carries a cracked black Onyx seal wired to its sternum.

barrow_wight.firstSightProse: Tarnished bronze scale chimes faintly in the crypt dark as a seven-foot skeleton rises off a stone bench, ducking beneath the lintel. Its elongated skull tilts downward while long bone fingers draw a broad, verdigris-stained blade.
barrow_wight.returnSightProse: A Long-Stride Skeleton towers in the crypt dark, bronze scales chiming.
barrow_wight.description: Oversized, bronze-clad dead of the lost northern builders, guarding Long Steps crypts.

intents.label: Scale Lock
intents.description: sets tarnished bronze across its ribs.

frozen_revenant.name: Gate-Sill Dead

visibleGear.weapon: Ice-crusted broken sword and frozen fists
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Blackened frostbite has snapped two toes off its left boot.

anatomy.faceDetail: Blackened nose and frost-split lips gape wide in silent rictus.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Ice fuses tattered wool straight to purple-black flesh.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Frozen black fingers clutch a snapped southern blade.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Stumps forward trailing crusts of cracked ice.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Thick hoarfrost steams cold off its open collar.

frozen_revenant.firstSightProse: Ice crackles like breaking glass as a blackened, frost-locked corpse heaves itself up out of a drift. Thick rime crusts its southern travel wool, and glazed eyes lock onto you as it raises a snapped, ice-rimmed sword.
frozen_revenant.returnSightProse: A Gate-Sill Dead stumps forward, trailing frost and snapped ice.
frozen_revenant.description: Traveler who froze solid near the threshold and dragged onward in blind, cold compulsion.

ossuary_sentinel.name: Grille-Armored Dead

visibleGear.weapon: Heavy wrought-iron cellar mace
visibleGear.armor: Rusted tomb-grille bars wired around bone
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Dozens of stolen Onyx coins rattle loose inside its iron-wired ribcage.

anatomy.faceDetail: Rusted iron straps bolt straight across a yellowed brow.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Bent cellar-grille bars cage a broad chest packed with dry bones.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Thick wire binds a heavy wrought-iron mace to its forearm.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Heavy iron-shod bones clang loud on limestone steps.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Onyx coins clink inside its hollow ribs with every blow.

ossuary_sentinel.firstSightProse: Wrought iron scrapes limestone as a towering, bone-and-grille figure blocks the cellar archway. Rusted cellar bars are wired straight onto yellowed ribs, and a heavy iron mace lifts slowly toward your skull.
ossuary_sentinel.returnSightProse: A Grille-Armored Dead clangs forward, iron bars rattling.
ossuary_sentinel.description: Bone Cellars guardian lashed together with rusted tomb-iron and filled with hoarded Onyx.

intents.label: Grille Mace
intents.description: hefts a massive iron cellar mace.

forge_automaton.name: Bronze Sluice-Warden

visibleGear.weapon: Pillar-thick bronze piston-maul
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A loose iron cotter-pin rattles inside its left hip gear.

anatomy.faceDetail: A headless bronze dome vents dull orange sparks through a narrow slit.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Heavy riveted boiler plates hiss steam along every seam.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Gear-driven arms end in a solid bronze maul and valve-hook.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Pistons slam down hard enough to shake wet basalt.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Numbered bronze tally-plates rivet across its chest.

forge_automaton.firstSightProse: Steam hisses shrill from a sunken pipe before a towering, headless hulk of tarnished bronze stomps down off the sluice-lip. Internal gears grind behind riveted boiler plates as a pillar-thick piston-maul lifts overhead.
forge_automaton.returnSightProse: The Bronze Sluice-Warden grinds forward, venting hot coal steam.
forge_automaton.description: Towering clockwork furnace-guard patrolling Smelter Pit's upper bronze valve.

aqueduct_surveyor.name: Brass Plumb-Walker

visibleGear.weapon: Heated iron measuring-spike
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: A spinning copper plumb-bob whirs inside its central lens.

anatomy.faceDetail: A thick glass eye-lens clicks loudly inside a rotating brass hood.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Cylindrical brass drum vents dry heat from charcoal embers.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Telescoping brass rod snaps out with a red-hot iron tip.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Three jointed bronze legs step cleanly across broken flagstones.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Ticks steadily like a grandfather clock before every jab.

aqueduct_surveyor.firstSightProse: Sharp clockwork clicks echo off broken arches as a three-legged brass drum stalks over the curb. Its cracked glass lens rotates toward your boots with a mechanical whir, and a red-hot measuring spike snaps out from its side.
aqueduct_surveyor.returnSightProse: A Brass Plumb-Walker clicks briskly across the stone.
aqueduct_surveyor.description: Three-legged late-imperial survey construct still patrolling High Road and Brick Hills drains.

gate_pendulum.name: Bronze Bell-Golem

visibleGear.weapon: Swinging bronze clapper-fists
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Hollow resonance amplifies every blow across stone.

anatomy.faceDetail: A solid cast-bronze bell-crown replaces any head or face.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Thick bell-metal cylinder rings softly with every step.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Twin bronze clapper-weights swing from heavy chains.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Stubby bronze pillars thud hard against marble.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Cracked lip along its chest leaks cold air.

gate_pendulum.firstSightProse: Deep metallic booming shakes dust off the North Gate lintel as a headless bronze bell-hulk lumbers into the arch. Heavy clapper-weights swing at the ends of thick chains, ringing low enough to rattle teeth inside your jaw.
gate_pendulum.returnSightProse: A Bronze Bell-Golem booms forward across the marble.
gate_pendulum.description: Heavy cast-bronze sentinel patrolling North Gate arches, shattering armor with concussive swings.

cinder_imp.name: Tallow-Sucking Fiend

visibleGear.weapon: Needle teeth and scalding tallow spit
visibleGear.armor: Raw, skinless red muscle slicked in grease
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Drinks lamp oil straight from stolen lanterns.

anatomy.faceDetail: Skinless red sinew pulls back around needle teeth and sulfur-yellow eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Visible grey ribs shine wetly with stolen mutton tallow.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long, four-fingered claws drip hot oil onto stone.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Scuttles backward up broken walls on goat-bent hocks.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Smells foully of burnt grease and sulfur.

cinder_imp.firstSightProse: Hot grease sizzles in the dark before a hunched, skinless thing scuttles down a column drum, licking spilled lamp oil off the stone. Wet red muscle gleams beneath sulfur-yellow eyes as needle teeth snap wide.
cinder_imp.returnSightProse: A Tallow-Sucking Fiend hisses low, dripping hot grease.
cinder_imp.description: Skinless horror bred in desperate Dry Arch blood-rites that steals lamp oil and spits scalding fat.

intents.label: Scalding Spit
intents.description: gulps hot grease inside its throat.

flayed_penitent.name: Flayed Apostate

visibleGear.weapon: Hooked iron flaying-chains
visibleGear.armor: Torn skin-strips hanging off raw sinew
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Bronze pins pierce straight through its ribs to ward off cold.

anatomy.faceDetail: Lidless white eyes stare wildly out of raw, salt-crusted face-muscle.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Tarnished bronze pins stab straight into exposed, steaming ribs.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Hooked iron chains dangle straight from pierced wrists.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Strides relentlessly through salt drifts without slowing.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Leaves steaming red footprints in dry cellar salt.

flayed_penitent.firstSightProse: Wet hooks clink against stone before a tall, lidless horror lurches out of a bone gallery. Flayed muscle steams in the cold air where bronze pins stab straight into its ribs, and hooked iron chains whip violently from pierced wrists.
flayed_penitent.returnSightProse: A Flayed Apostate stalks forward, hooked chains screaming.
flayed_penitent.description: Apostate twisted beyond human limits inside Bone Cellars after trying to flay out northern numbness.

pit_maw.name: Slag-Belly Horror

visibleGear.weapon: Split belly-maw and slag-caked claws
visibleGear.armor: Vitrified black glass crusted over fat
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Half-melted iron buckles jut out of its swollen gut.

anatomy.faceDetail: Clustered orange eyes blink above a jawless face split straight to the belly.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: A second jagged tooth-ring opens wetly across its bloated stomach.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Heavy claws crusted in black kiln glass drag along the ground.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Lumbers on thick, blistered stumps across glowing slag.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Belches sour acid and glowing cinders together.

pit_maw.firstSightProse: Glazed black slag crunches under massive weight as a bloated, glass-crusted horror heaves itself out of a furnace-pit. Its chest splits vertically into a second jagged mouth steaming with orange heat and sour bile.
pit_maw.returnSightProse: A Slag-Belly Horror heaves forward, glowing cinders spilling from its gut.
pit_maw.description: Swollen furnace abomination festering beneath Brick Hills slag-pits.

intents.label: Belly Crunch
intents.description: lunges forward with its split torso-maw.

intents.label: Slag Belch
intents.description: heaves glowing cinders from its gut.

pale_mirror_stalker.name: Glass-Skinned Echo

visibleGear.weapon: Razor-thin frost glass limbs
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Casts no shadow under direct moonlight.

anatomy.faceDetail: A smooth, featureless curve of silvered ice reflects your own torchlight back.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Translucent pale ribs pulse faintly in silence.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Elongated limbs taper to razor-sharp frost glass.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Mirrors your exact footwork half a beat late.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Air freezes into silent frost-rings around its heels.

pale_mirror_stalker.firstSightProse: Air snaps dead-quiet under white moonlight as a tall, faceless silhouette steps out of a marble colonnade. Its smooth silvered skin reflects your own lantern back without eyes or mouth, and every joint moves in uncanny mimicry of your own stance.
pale_mirror_stalker.returnSightProse: A Glass-Skinned Echo glides silently across the frost, mirroring your stance.
pale_mirror_stalker.description: Ultra-rare lunar anomaly manifesting only under Full Moon alignment or extreme Defilement.

intents.label: Hollow Mirror
intents.description: tilts its blank silver face toward yours.

silver_chorister.name: Moon-Tuned Resonance

visibleGear.weapon: Spinning silver-plated ribs and harmonic rings
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Hummed pitches match the exact intervals of the 12-day moon cycle.

anatomy.faceDetail: No head exists—only three concentric silver rings hovering above pale ribs.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Hollow silvered rib-arcs spin slowly in dead silence.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Thin frost-threads lash outward whenever a ring aligns.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Hovers six inches above pale marble without touching the frost.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Draws loose silver dust upward into slow orbits.

silver_chorister.firstSightProse: Frost lifts gently off the floor without wind as three concentric silver rings drift between white pillars, hovering above a cage of pale, hollow ribs. A freezing hum vibrates straight inside your skull before a single sound reaches your ears.
silver_chorister.returnSightProse: A Moon-Tuned Resonance hovers silently, rings turning in cold air.
silver_chorister.description: Strictly scarce cosmic anomaly found only inside The White Dome under peak lunar alignment.

intents.label: Phase Orbit
intents.description: spins its outer bronze arcs tight.

malakor.name: Crowned Dome-Prelate

visibleGear.weapon: Bronze bell-crozier fused into bone
visibleGear.armor: Cracked bell-crown and rotted silver-threaded robes
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Three bronze seals bind his hollow chest to the sunken pit.

anatomy.faceDetail: A cracked bronze bell-crown bites deep into pale, unblinking brows.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Silver-threaded rags part over a cavernous chest ringing with cold air.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Long, bone-white fingers fuse directly around a bronze crozier.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Stands planted atop the cracked bronze dais.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Cold air rushes steadily out from beneath his cracked crown.

malakor.firstSightProse: Freezing air surges up from the sunken dais as a towering, silver-robed figure rises slowly behind a fractured bronze bell. A heavy bell-crown sits riveted into chalk-white brows, and bone-white fingers lift a bronze crozier fused straight to his wrist.
malakor.returnSightProse: The Crowned Dome-Prelate stands enthroned beneath the fractured white dome.
malakor.description: Hollowed prelate enthroned in the drowned pit beneath The White Dome.

intents.label: Cold Pull
intents.description: draws freezing air through his hollow ribs.

quarry_matriarch.name: The Slate-Back Queen

visibleGear.weapon: Crushing quarry-pincers and acid spray
visibleGear.hiddenDetail: Indestructible black Onyx coins lie fused into her thick dorsal plates.

anatomy.faceDetail: Twin wagon-tongue pincers drip smoking black acid below pale green eyes.
anatomy.chestTorsoDetail: Broad slate-black dorsal plates carry fused Onyx shards like armor studs.
anatomy.armsHandsDetail: Forelimbs thick as pit-props slam down to pin prey.
anatomy.legsStanceDetail: Twelve jointed legs grip sheer quarry walls effortlessly.
anatomy.distinguishingMark: Rattles like falling slate whenever she turns.

quarry_matriarch.firstSightProse: Bronze hoist chains snap tight as a wagon-sized, slate-armored crawler heaves up out of the deepest quarry shaft. Sharp black Onyx shards stud her overlapping dorsal plates while smoking acid pools beneath twin crushing pincers.
quarry_matriarch.returnSightProse: The Slate-Back Queen blocks the quarry shaft, pincers dripping acid.
quarry_matriarch.description: Apex acid-crawler matriarch nested beneath Black Quarry, armored in fused Onyx shards.

intents.label: Acid Flood
intents.description: heaves green acid across the stone.
